slice: Whole-contract gap matrix, one implemented correctness guard and its verification

product_change.change: PaletteEnter now returns early while the query has a marked (uncommitted) IME composition, and a private predicate composition_in_progress records that rule
product_change.why: the palette bound Enter unconditionally to PaletteActivate, so an Enter arriving during a composition would execute whatever command was highlighted for a half-typed query
product_change.risk: a command triggered from uncommitted text; the guard only suppresses activation while a marked range exists, and does not alter key handling for committed text
product_change.safety: no new API, dependency, unsafe/FFI, TSF work, token or contract change

AX01_accessibility.contract_requirement: screen-reader names/roles; accessible identity of virtualized rows; keyboard reachability; active descendant and focus consistency
AX01_accessibility.existing_implementation: role/aria_label/aria_value on the three text inputs (the rail value added in §19.95), roles and labels on rail rows, dock cards, inspector sections and surfaces
AX01_accessibility.existing_tests: crate tests cover the input routing and command facts; no accessibility-tree assertions in the crate
AX01_accessibility.existing_native_evidence: UIA dumps show 41 named elements, the four Latin labels, the Japanese label and three mixed-script names; DC-MP-AX1 records that static shell text is absent from the tree
AX01_accessibility.remaining_gap: static shell text (state-axis values, some surface labels) is still absent from the accessibility tree; an active-descendant relation is not implemented; no assistive-technology session has been run
AX01_accessibility.required_change: exposing static status text and an active descendant needs an accessibility design decision and a broader surface change, not a one-line fix
AX01_accessibility.verification: accessibility-tree dump per surface plus a screen-reader session
AX01_accessibility.authority: design decision (static-text exposure) and an assistive-technology session

AX02_ime.contract_requirement: composition start/update/commit/cancel; preedit; caret/selection during composition; per-surface isolation; behaviour across focus moves and popups; no command dispatch from a partial composition; candidate window and TSF observability
AX02_ime.existing_implementation: EntityInputHandler with per-surface marked ranges; commit and cancel splice only the marked range; this slice adds the palette activation guard
AX02_ime.existing_tests: ime_tests (5 cases) plus the new composition_in_progress case; 87 crate tests pass
AX02_ime.existing_native_evidence: §19.95 commits and mixed input; §19.96 preedit, operator cancel, commit and rail-to-flow switch; this slice: a partial composition plus Enter left the palette open and executed no command
AX02_ime.remaining_gap: which layer suppressed that Enter (IME consumption or the new guard) is not separated; caret/selection geometry during composition, candidate window and TSF internals are unobservable here
AX02_ime.required_change: none identified for commit/cancel/isolation; TSF introspection would need a new capability
AX02_ime.verification: per-step Native observation with the operator; unit tests for the splice rules
AX02_ime.authority: none for what is implemented; TSF instrumentation would need a design decision

AX03_focus.contract_requirement: palette/dialog focus restoration on close; keyboard traversal; focus and selection across virtualized inserts/removals; focus preserved across surface switches
AX03_focus.existing_implementation: palette_open stores the focused element and the close path restores it; surface navigation keeps per-surface focus handles
AX03_focus.existing_tests: crate tests cover navigation facts; restoration itself is not unit-tested
AX03_focus.existing_native_evidence: no recorded restoration observation; §19.96's attempt was inconclusive because the OS focus was outside the application
AX03_focus.remaining_gap: restoration after close, popup close and surface switching is unobserved; the 125 % capture HOLD blocks pixel-level confirmation
AX03_focus.verification: Native: open the palette, type, close, then read the focused element

AX04_high_contrast_motion.contract_requirement: High Contrast selection and focus distinguishable, no colour-only signalling, readable text, motion audit, Reduced Motion honoured
AX04_high_contrast_motion.existing_implementation: non-colour cues exist (labels, focus outlines); a motion audit was recorded; High Contrast theme integration is not implemented
AX04_high_contrast_motion.existing_native_evidence: non-color cue run (historical); no High Contrast run
AX04_high_contrast_motion.remaining_gap: High Contrast integration is NOT_IMPLEMENTED; Reduced Motion is applicable-by-audit only
AX04_high_contrast_motion.required_change: design decision for the High Contrast theme and OS setting changes performed by the operator
AX04_high_contrast_motion.verification: operator-driven High Contrast and Reduced Motion sessions
AX04_high_contrast_motion.authority: design decision plus operator OS changes

AX05_dpi_monitor.contract_requirement: 100/125/150/175/200 % matrix, real DPI and coordinate systems, fractional-DPI hit targets, popup geometry, clipping, focus/selection/scroll anchor, mixed-DPI movement, resize/reopen, unsupported combinations
AX05_dpi_monitor.existing_implementation: token-derived separator and focus outline; per-monitor scale read at render
AX05_dpi_monitor.existing_native_evidence: 96 DPI observations (§19.90, §19.92); 120 DPI scale confirmed at §19.93 but the identity-bound capture is refused at 43/49
AX05_dpi_monitor.remaining_gap: no accepted 125 % image, no 150/175/200 %, no mixed-monitor run; §19.94's two remedies both need authority
AX05_dpi_monitor.required_change: the capture-path decision recorded in §19.94; the rest needs operator display changes
AX05_dpi_monitor.verification: one accepted image per scale plus a mixed-monitor move
AX05_dpi_monitor.authority: the §19.94 decision and operator display changes
